title: Review round — new burst, resumed session · MVP as built, 2026-07

messages.label: Review PR #P: request changes
messages.note: machine findings (reviewer App / Copilot) trigger the same round — anything above the last_review_id cursor

messages.label: Materialize the task session into a fresh volume
messages.note: possibly days later, any host — durable state = branch + PR thread + session

messages.label: Spawn NEW burst (resume = session_id): unseen reviews verbatim + inline comments

messages.note: one persistent session per task; attempts × budget = installment plan — a budget-killed burst resumes where it died

messages.label: Push fixes; reply in every thread (fix / reply / defer)
Advance review cursor (only after a successful round)
Re-request by trigger: owner round → providers + owner · machine round → providers only
messages.note: caps: owner rounds hard-block at 3 (re-ready resets); machine rounds soft-cap — cursor advances, comment, human gate holds
